name: The Bookish Girl
description: Book lists for cozy readers: romance by trope, mystery and thriller page-turners, comforting feel-good reads and Kindle Unlimited finds.
author: Vallari Gadre

sections.name: Book Lists
sections.blurb: Romance books by trope: enemies to lovers, grumpy sunshine, fake dating and more, with Kindle Unlimited picks marked.

sections.name: Romantasy
sections.blurb: Dragons, fae courts and slow-burn magic for when real life is not dramatic enough.

sections.name: Kindle & Reading
sections.blurb: Kindles, audiobooks, reading nooks and the little things that make reading better.

sections.name: Mystery & Thriller
sections.blurb: Twisty thrillers, cozy mysteries and whodunits you'll read in one sitting.

sections.name: Cozy Reads
sections.blurb: Gentle, comforting books about bookshops, cafes and second chances, for when you need a hug in book form.

sections.name: Gift Guides

heroAlt: A stack of paperbacks and a Kindle on a cozy blanket beside a mug of tea in warm lamplight
authorBio: I read every day, so these lists come from a reader, not a robot: the romance tropes I can't resist, the mysteries and thrillers that keep me up past midnight, the cozy feel-good books that feel like a hug, and the Kindle Unlimited finds worth your time.

banner.text: New to Kindle Unlimited? Read thousands of romances free for 30 days

freebie.title: Get the 2027 romance trope bingo card
freebie.blurb: A printable bingo card of 25 romance tropes to read your way through 2027, plus a new romance list in your inbox each week.

tropes.name: Enemies to lovers
tropes.blurb: They can't stand each other, until they can't stay away. Our favorite rivals-turned-lovers romances.

tropes.name: Grumpy sunshine
tropes.blurb: One scowls, one smiles, and somehow it works. Grumpy sunshine romances worth staying up for.

tropes.name: Fake dating
tropes.blurb: It was only supposed to be pretend. Fake dating romances where the feelings get very real.

tropes.name: Small town
tropes.blurb: Cozy main streets, nosy neighbors and slow-burn love in small-town romances.

tropes.name: Second chance
tropes.blurb: The one that got away comes back. Second chance romances for when you want all the feelings.

tropes.name: Hockey romance
tropes.blurb: Ice, rivalries and big hearts: the hockey romances everyone is reading.

tropes.name: Romantasy
tropes.blurb: Dragons, fae courts and slow-burn magic, for readers who want romance with real stakes.

tropes.name: Holiday romance
tropes.blurb: Snowy small towns, matching pajamas and mistletoe kisses: cozy holiday romances.

tropes.name: Regency
tropes.blurb: Ballrooms, rakes and witty heroines: Regency romances for Bridgerton fans.

tropes.name: Brother's best friend
tropes.blurb: Off limits, which is exactly the problem. Brother's best friend romances full of secret glances and slow burn.

tropes.name: Forced proximity
tropes.blurb: One cabin, one bed, nowhere to run. Forced proximity and snowed in romances.

tropes.name: Friends to lovers
tropes.blurb: They were always there. Friends to lovers romances where the best love story starts as a friendship.

tropes.name: Spicy romance
tropes.blurb: Turn the heat up: spicy romance books for readers who like their love stories steamy.
